description: Identify federal suppliers, bid teams, procurement advisors, and capture leaders with an immediate procurement intelligence problem.
Document the client's current opportunity discovery, qualification, compliance, pricing, proposal, and approval workflow.
Tailor the existing certified demo journey to the client's business problem without changing frozen intelligence logic.
Confirm required user, organization, workflow, and procurement data inputs for onboarding.
Agree on measurable outcomes such as time saved, opportunities qualified, risks identified, or bid decisions improved.
Operate the platform with a controlled client workflow and capture evidence, issues, usage, and value.
Use demonstrated business value to move the client into a paid subscription, advisory engagement, or managed intelligence service.
